items.title: 66960_Gil Evans oral history interview
items.q: He and I wrote some things together.

ctx.x: Do you remember the first thing that you wrote?

Mostly. (unintelligible) Well yes, Ned and, this fellow told you about... I scored out songs. He and I wrote some things together. We were trying to remember how they went. We couldn't remember, we could remember the titles but we couldn't remember how they went. (LAUGHTER).
Which means you don't have those (the articles?) of early manuscripts around any more?
